summary: Real Asset Acquisition Corp. (RAAQ), a SPAC, filed an 8-K announcing the availability of a Capital Markets Day Presentation by IQM Quantum Computers Oy regarding their pending business combination. The transaction was originally announced on February 22, 2026. The SEC declared the registration statement effective on June 5, 2026, and RAAQ has mailed the definitive proxy statement/prospectus to shareholders of record as of June 3, 2026, for an extraordinary general meeting to vote on the deal. No financial terms, premium, or break fee are disclosed in this filing. This is a procedural update in the SPAC merger process. Watch for the shareholder vote and potential redemptions ahead of close.
